aggregation_check.note: A and B can only diverge if a seed file has other than 74 task records; identical values mean aggregation choice does not explain any gap to the paper's printed figure.

verdict_text: Attribution-corrected Mean R2 (-0.7054) is negative on the 5-seed average, undercutting the paper's claimed sign reversal (negative -> +0.8721). Raw Mean R2 was outside tolerance of the printed figure, but the sign-reversal claim itself does not survive attribution correction.
